1.consolidated_definition: der. Enviar a una persona que ha cometido un delito al país cuya justicia lo reclama. Anglicismo adaptado, usual. DRAE 2001, del inglés. Por poco ocurre una tragedia. Tuvieron que intervenir autoridades municipales, listas a extraditar al circo del país
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Extradite (verb). To send a person who has committed a crime to the country whose justice is seeking them. Anglicism adapted, commonly used. 

Note: In this context, "circo" refers to a traveling circus or carnival, which in some cases may be associated with illicit activities.
